Boiling-limited: the cover needs T_c = 80.3 C (Psat = 48.6 kPa) but the set chamber pressure is 10.0 kPa (T_sat = 45.8 C). No steady state at the set pressure; the chamber floats to 48.6 kPa, the vacuum does not help and evaporation is energy-limited (vapour extraction by the ejector is not modelled).

Vacuum load on the cover: 73.8 kN (~7.5 tonnes) at 52.7 kPa below ambient over 1.40 m2. Plate-bending screen gives ~212 MPa in a 10 mm pane (allowable here 20 MPa): a vacuum like this is only credible for a SMALL, ribbed or curved, sealed chamber, not a flat glass cover of this size. Screening estimate only, not structural validity.

eta_thermal.notes: Fraction of absorbed energy that drives evaporation vs. lost.

h_fg.notes: Latent heat of vaporization near 50-70 C (temperature-varying).

mass_transfer_coefficient.notes: Effective vapour mass-transfer coefficient (order of magnitude for solar stills).

empirical_flux.notes: Empirical evaporation flux. 8.4 kg/m^2/day over 8 h -> 1.05 kg/m^2/h. Cite 396.

condensation_coefficient.notes: Inner-side film-condensation coefficient on glass (order-of-magnitude, not looked up; re-tagged from 'literature' to ASSUMED when the coupled solver made it a real resistance).

gap_convection_coefficient.notes: Convective (sensible, air/vapour) coupling evaporator -> glass across the vapour gap. Natural convection in a hot still is typically ~1-4 W/m2K; the radiative part is added separately from the emissivities. Calibrate on prototype.

diffusion_path_length.notes: EFFECTIVE vapour diffusion path through air in the gap, natural-convection enhancement included. Geometric gap is 0.1-0.3 m, but convection shortens the effective path to ~1-2 cm (Dunkle-equivalent). Strongest unknown in the coupled model: CALIBRATE ON PROTOTYPE.

glass_absorptance.notes: Fraction of the light crossing the cover that is absorbed in the glass (heats the cover). Low-iron glass is a few percent; thickness dependent, not looked up.

motive_water_temperature.notes: Temperature of the ejector motive water; its vapour pressure is the hard floor of the ejector (cavitation). Set to the tank/ambient temperature.

chamber_leak_pressure_floor.notes: Lowest absolute pressure the sealed chamber can hold given leaks / air ingress. Measure with a vacuum-decay test; 10 kPa is a guess for a glass-and-gasket cover.

pump_efficiency.notes: Wire-to-water efficiency of the motive pump (small centrifugal pump).

glass_allowable_stress.notes: Allowable bending stress used ONLY for the cover-vacuum warning. Order of magnitude for annealed glass design loads; NOT a structural design value.
